invariants.rationale: If divisor is zero, the method returns Integer.MIN_VALUE.
When b is zero, result is Integer.MIN_VALUE which is negative.
When b is nonzero, result times b equals a (integer division definition).
Only when b is not zero do we perform division and return a/b.

meta.value: division only happens if b is non-zero
